description: Talk to your eesel AI support agent from ChatGPT. eesel connects to a company's helpdesk, docs and past tickets and answers customer questions from them. With this app, ChatGPT can ask your agent questions and get answers from your connected sources, check what is connected and synced, review what the agent has done, list and change its automations, read and edit its instructions, approve or deny actions waiting on a person, and list or upload the files you share with it. Your eesel role decides what ChatGPT can change, and writes follow the approval settings in your eesel workspace. Requires an eesel workspace; sign in with your eesel account.
